definition: Causing or involving sudden, violent, and far-reaching destruction.
author: Herbert George Wells
quote: You must figure the tumult suddenly striking on the unstable equilibrium of old Fletcher’s planks and two chairs—with cataclysmic results.
example_sentence: The storm had a cataclysmic effect on the coastal road.
